decisions.reason: As a newly launched but technically adjacent spraying system, it is niche yet well within the firm's competence base, so a medium-sized established manufacturer with some innovation slack would likely keep it while learning about demand.
This pump is very close to the core offer and was given its own webpage, which suggests commitment and expected fit with customer needs, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Because it extends the existing pump and material-handling range and already exists as a line with several models, management would likely view it as worth retaining despite early-market uncertainty.

Although somewhat more specialized, it builds on the firm's established systems business and its standalone presentation indicates strategic relevance, so behavioral-theory logic points to continued support rather than rapid exit.
